sloka: ततः परे समुद्रस्य गदा पाणिर् विभीषणः ।परेषाम् अभिघत अर्थम् अतिष्ठत् सचिवैः सह ॥६-२२-७९॥।।
transliteration: tataḥ pare samudrasya gadā pāṇir vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।pareṣām abhighata artham atiṣṭhat sacivaiḥ saha ॥6-22-79॥।।

translations.english: There upon Vibheeshana holding the mace stood on the other side of the ocean along with his friends to slay the enemies.
